title: Pricing Overview
text:
Pricing Overview | Google Cloud

# Google Cloud pricing

Save money with Google Cloud’s transparent and innovative approach to pricing. Estimate your costs with our pricing calculator or contact us to get a quote for your organization.

Start running workloads for free

Create an account to evaluate how Google Cloud products perform in real-world scenarios. New customers get $300 in free credits to run, test, and deploy workloads, including Google-recommended, pre-built solutions. All customers can use 20+ products for free, up to monthly usage limits.

$300

in free credits 

20+

free products

Only pay for what you use

With Google Cloud’s pay-as-you-go pricing structure, you only pay for the services you use. No up-front fees. No termination charges. Pricing varies by product and usage— view detailed price list.

Save up to 57% on workloads

Google Cloud saves you money over other providers through automatic savings based on monthly usage and by pre-paying for resources at discounted rates. For example, save up to 57% with committed use discounts on Compute Engine resources like machine types or GPUs.

2:48

Gain visibility into current cost trends and forecasts

Stay in control of your spending

Control your spending with budgets, alerts, quota limits, and other free cost management tools. Optimize costs with actionable, AI-powered intelligent recommendations and custom dashboards that display cost trends and forecasts. 

We’re here to help with free 24/7 billing support.

Estimate your costs 

Understand how your costs can fluctuate based on location, workloads, and other variables with the pricing calculator. Or get a custom quote by connecting with a sales representative.

## Why choose a subscription plan?

Eliminate budget surprises

Switch to a single, predictable monthly cost and focus more on building, less on billing.

Innovate with more products

Use your plan's generous calls to test and build with any included product, all at one fixed rate.

Track usage with alerts

Modify your plan at any time
